children: US surgical robotics firm's Q3 revenue rose 20% yr/yr but missed analyst expectations
System revenue grew 60% yr/yr, driven by new Genesis and Synchrony system sales
Company announced $24 mln convertible note financing to boost liquidity
Company expects growing recurring revenue and more consistent capital sales in coming qtrs
Stereotaxis expects adjusted operating expenses to approximate $8 mln per qtr going forward
Company says revenue growth and stable expenses may lead to cash-flow profitability within next yr
NEW SYSTEM SALES - Co said system revenue growth was driven by GenesisX and Genesis system sales in US and China, and Synchrony digital operating room systems
CATHETER SALES - Co said recurring revenue benefited from new robotically-navigated catheter portfolio, but was limited by supply shortages
LOW PRODUCTION VOLUME - Co said gross margins were affected by fixed overhead costs spread over low production volume
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Stereotaxis Inc is $3.00, about 163.2% above its November 9 closing price of $1.14
